capstones.name: Warlord's Bravery
capstones.effect: For 30 rounds, +30% mitigation, +25% damage, immune to dragon fear.
capstones.description: The warlord stands brave before the wyrms themselves.

capstones.name: Holyforge
capstones.effect: Self buff (50 rounds): weapon procs holy fire (200 DD + undead/dragon bane). +20% damage vs dragons.
capstones.description: The paladin's weapon is forged in holy fire.

capstones.name: Soul Abrasion
capstones.effect: Target takes 1500 + (level × 12) damage over 5 rounds. Heals SK for 50% of damage. Reduces target's resists by 20.
capstones.description: The shadowknight abrades the victim's very soul.

mechanics.notes: Damage dealt over 30 seconds (5 rounds). Heals SK for 50% of damage dealt. Reduces target's resists by 20.

capstones.name: Zan Fi's Whistle
capstones.effect: For 30 rounds, +35% damage, +20% attack speed, +15% accuracy.
capstones.description: Zan Fi's whistle guides the monk's fists with perfect control.

capstones.name: Thief's Eyes
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, +40% accuracy, +25% crit chance, see invisible, see through disguises.
capstones.description: The rogue sees all — nothing hides from thief's eyes.

capstones.name: Reckless Abandon
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, +60% damage, +30% accuracy, +20% crit. Take +25% damage. Cannot be stopped.
capstones.description: The berserker abandons all restraint for pure destruction.

capstones.name: Flaming Arrows
capstones.effect: For 50 rounds, bow attacks deal +300 fire damage.
capstones.description: The ranger's arrows burn with dragonfire.

capstones.name: Protection of the Warder
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, damage is split 50/50 between beastlord and warder. Both gain +20% mitigation.
capstones.description: The warder interposes itself, sharing the master's pain.

capstones.name: Cacophony
capstones.effect: Aura (20 rounds): enemies take 100/tick sonic damage and -20% attack speed. Allies gain +15% damage.
capstones.description: The bard's cacophony shatters enemy resolve.

capstones.name: Divine Guardian
capstones.effect: Target buff (50 rounds): 30% chance to block 50% of incoming damage. Cannot be dispelled.

capstones.name: Wrath of the Wild
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, +50% spell damage, spells cost -30% mana, +20% crit chance.
capstones.description: The wild's wrath pours through the druid unchecked.

capstones.name: Prophetic Guard
capstones.effect: Group buff (100 rounds): +500 HP, +30% healing received, +20 to all resists.
capstones.description: The shaman's prophecy guards the tribe.

capstones.name: Phantasmal Opponent
capstones.effect: Summon a phantasmal copy of the target for 10 rounds. It attacks the original at 75% effectiveness.
capstones.description: The enemy faces its own phantasmal twin.

mechanics.description: Summons a phantasmal copy of the target for 1 minute. It attacks the original at 75% effectiveness.

capstones.name: Servant of Ro
capstones.effect: Summon the Servant of Ro (powerful fire pet) for 50 rounds. Deals massive fire damage, immune to fire.
capstones.description: The mighty Servant of Ro answers the magician's call.

mechanics.description: Summons the Servant of Ro (powerful fire pet) for 5 minutes. Deals massive fire damage, immune to fire.

capstones.name: Gift of Deathly Resolve
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, DoTs have 40% chance to twincast.
capstones.description: Death's resolve doubles the necromancer's decay.

capstones.name: Arcane Destruction
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, +45% spell damage, +25% crit chance, mana cost -25%.
